subject: Prominent Personalities of Bihar
description: Eduteria Bihar Tathya Sangrah · Prominent Personalities of Bihar

questions.q: Dr. Rajendra Prasad, the first President of India, belonged to which state?
questions.source: Eduteria PYQ set — 66th BPSC (Re) Preliminary Exam (BH-EDU-025)

questions.q: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was awarded the 'Bharat Ratna' in which year?
questions.source: Eduteria PYQ set — CDPO Preliminary Exam 2005 (BH-EDU-090)

questions.explanation: Dr. Shri Krishna Singh, the first Chief Minister of independent Bihar, is known as 'Bihar Kesari'. Anugrah Narayan Sinha is 'Bihar Vibhuti'.

questions.q: Who is called the 'Lok Nayak' (leader of the people)?
questions.explanation: Jayaprakash Narayan is popularly known as 'Lok Nayak'. He led the Total Revolution (1975) and was awarded the Magsaysay Award in 1965.

questions.q: Who is called the 'Shakespeare of Bhojpuri', famous for his work 'Videshiya'?
questions.explanation: Bhikhari Thakur, born at Kutubpur (Saran) in 1887, is called the Shakespeare of Bhojpuri; 'Videshiya' is his most famous work.

questions.q: Who is known as 'Bihar Vibhuti', who assisted Gandhiji in the Champaran Satyagraha and later became a Bihar minister?
questions.explanation: Anugrah Narayan Sinha (born Poiwa, Aurangabad, 1887) is called 'Bihar Vibhuti'.

questions.q: Who is called the 'Father of Total Revolution' (Sampoorna Kranti) and was awarded the Magsaysay Award in 1965?
questions.explanation: Jayaprakash Narayan led the Sampoorna Kranti (Total Revolution) in 1975 and received the Magsaysay Award in 1965.
Ramdhari Singh Dinkar (born Simaria, Begusarai, 1908) is called 'Rashtrakavi' after independence; major works include Kurukshetra, Urvashi, Hunkar, Renuka.

questions.q: Which regional Hindi novelist wrote 'Maila Anchal'?
questions.explanation: Phanishwar Nath Renu (born 1921, Aurahi-Forbesganj, Araria) is a regional novelist whose major work is 'Maila Anchal'.

questions.q: Which poet, known as 'Maithil Kavi Kokil', wrote in Maithili and Sanskrit (Purana Sangrah, Vibhasagar)?
questions.explanation: Vidyapati, a Shringar Rasa poet of Darbhanga, is called 'Maithil Kavi Kokil'. His Sanskrit works include Purana Sangrah, Vibhasagar and Ganga Kavyavali.

questions.q: Which famous Acharya of Vikramshila University was invited to Tibet by the Tibetan ruler?
questions.explanation: Dipankar Shrigyan, a famous Acharya of Vikramshila University, went to Tibet at the invitation of the Tibetan ruler to propagate Buddhism.

questions.q: Who established the famous Khuda Baksh Library of Patna?
questions.explanation: Khan Bahadur Khudabakhsh Khan (born 1842, Ukhai, Siwan) founded the Khuda Baksh Library; since 1969 it has been under the Government of India.

questions.q: Which shehnai maestro, born at Dumraon (Buxar) in 1916, was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2001?
questions.explanation: Ustad Bismillah Khan, the world-famous shehnai player born at Dumraon, Buxar, played at the Red Fort on the first Independence Day and got the Bharat Ratna in 2001.

questions.q:
Match the personality with his nickname: 1. Ramdhari Singh Dinkar 2. Karpoori Thakur 3. Anugrah Narayan Sinha 4. Jayaprakash Narayan
A. Jan Nayak
B. Bihar Vibhuti
C. Rashtra Kavi
D. Lok Nayak
questions.explanation: Dinkar = Rashtra Kavi, Karpoori Thakur = Jan Nayak, Anugrah Narayan Sinha = Bihar Vibhuti, Jayaprakash Narayan = Lok Nayak.
